query: What concrete fidelity thresholds, an adaptation coding scheme (levels and examples), and clear rules will trigger protocol amendments versus acceptable local adaptations?

response.query: What concrete fidelity thresholds, an adaptation coding scheme (levels and examples), and clear rules will trigger protocol amendments versus acceptable local adaptations?
response.answer: Protocol amendments require significant deviations; local adaptations are acceptable for minor changes. Fidelity thresholds are set by program standards; adaptations must maintain core curriculum integrity. Clear rules for amendments involve formal review and approval processes.
